taskPurpose.exactNormativeText: Workspace/public mode enforces tenant isolation for rows, artifacts, cache, queues, sessions, quotas, logs, signed URLs, metrics, and model context with cross-tenant adversarial tests.

Abuse controls cover request floods, expensive-query amplification, quota exhaustion, source scraping, alert harvesting, prompt attacks, resource enumeration, and market-manipulation feedback loops without weakening protected risk monitoring.
Security incidents have severity, owner, containment, evidence preservation, credential rotation, customer/owner notification policy, recovery verification, postmortem, and regression test.

Production release requires a threat model and automated security suite for every trust boundary, including MCP, admin, webhooks, providers, collector, model, database, object store, Alpha Lab, notifications, and public distribution.
